As expected of the "Twinkle Series"……

text_block_list.text:
"The stronger the opponents I face, the stronger I become!
Yes, just like how a pearl grows bigger!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Which means today's close loss only made my potential even bigger!
choice_data_list: I can take your word for that, right?
I can take your word for that, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you. But my sights are set on the world—I can't just rest on those laurels.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"To aim even higher,
we're heading to training!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course! Just leave everything to me and relax!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a front-row seat
to the moment I change history!
